method: BTO projects within about 1 km (straight line, nearest block), found by grouping HDB blocks by their OneMap building name. Completed projects use HDB unit counts; under-construction projects use BTOHQ (unverified). Earliest resale is completion plus the minimum occupation period (5 years; 10 for Plus and Prime) and is an estimate.

resale.method: Sold HDB flats in blocks within 1 km (straight line), from HDB Existing Building and HDB Property Information on data.gov.sg; blocks were matched by postal code through OneMap. Sales are HDB resale registrations over the last 12 months of data. Rental flats are excluded because they cannot be resold. "Young" means a lease that started within the last 10 years.
resale.source: HDB via data.gov.sg (resale flat prices, property information, existing buildings); OneMap
